mapper.insert: insert into branch_account (branch_id, branch_code, auth_key_hash, status, created_at, deleted_at, name, address) values (uuid_to_bin(#{branchId}), #{code}, #{authKeyHash}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{deletedAt}, #{name}, #{address}) on duplicate key update auth_key_hash = values(auth_key_hash), status = values(status), deleted_at = values(deleted_at), name = values(name), address = values(address)
mapper.select: select branch_id, branch_code, auth_key_hash, status, created_at, deleted_at, name, address from branch_account where branch_id = #{branchId}
select branch_id, branch_code, auth_key_hash, status, created_at, deleted_at, name, address from branch_account where branch_code = #{code}
select branch_id, branch_code, auth_key_hash, status, created_at, deleted_at, name, address from branch_account where name = #{name}
select branch_id, branch_code, auth_key_hash, status, created_at, deleted_at, name, address from branch_account
